mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever caught yourself wondering where the line is between ordinary quirks and true madness? Or who actually decides what makes someone "sane"? Together, we're about to peel back the curtain on a world that's equal parts fascinating and unsettling—one where questions about the mind, and what it means to be normal, take center stage. In The Psychopath Test: A Journey Through the Madness Industry, John Marrs invites us to join him as he steps into the shadows of psychological diagnosis. He takes us on a journey where labels can be both powerful and dangerous, and where the boundary between eccentricity, brilliance, and real pathology can be razor-thin. We'll meet the people who do the diagnosing—and those who find themselves under the microscope. Along the way, we'll see just how fragile our systems can be, and how a simple question—what is normal?—can ripple through lives and institutions in ways we might never expect. This isn't just about understanding psychopaths. It's about reflecting on humanity itself—on empathy, on uncertainty, and on how we all fit into a world that's constantly trying to define us. So, as we set out together, get ready to challenge your assumptions. There’s a lot to uncover, and it just might change the way you see the world—and yourself.
